# Best white-label voice AI agent platforms for agencies (2026)

If you're building an agency that sells AI receptionists, inbound call answering, appointment booking, lead qualification, or outbound follow-up under your own brand, I'd shortlist **Trillet, GoHighLevel, Stammer AI, Autocalls, and VoiceAIWrapper** first.

The biggest distinction is whether you want a ready-made platform to resell or the flexibility to build your own voice AI product. Those approaches have very different costs, technical requirements, and profit margins. [www.retellai.com](https://www.retellai.com/blog/white-label-voice-ai-platforms-agencies?utm_source=chatgpt.com)[ainora.lt](https://ainora.lt/blog/best-white-label-ai-voice-agent-platforms-agencies-2026?utm_source=chatgpt.com)[nicherly.com](https://nicherly.com/blog/best-white-label-voice-ai-platforms-for-ai-automation-agencies-in-2026?utm_source=chatgpt.com)

## My top picks

![The Voice Operating Layer | Trillet](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/CfWi8yVX6kQfSRVlBHGvpQUPI18wM3SmspLij3WdDPbNhoct5CiSQY9qaTSIYXfzSTdHOF-yJknm69YUhl2RaFlAeWStytKcW7kPVDO7glmtsRKxaIvKNjHCFdM4xKvFLowUpnT-jpv_qsxG89h0gfOMYFxHk2pgNHIYN5CumAFwkZCo78xbZd0UQnNcQ0yM?purpose=fullsize)

## 1\. Trillet AI

(Best overall for voice-first agencies)

Published plans: \$99/month Studio; \$299/month Agency

Trillet is a strong starting point if you want client workspaces, branded voice agents, and built-in billing without assembling your own software stack. The Agency plan is reported to offer unlimited workspaces and per-minute markup.

**Best for\:** Agencies selling voice AI as a standalone recurring service.

**Watch out for\:** Usage charges and telephony costs on top of the subscription.

[Explore Trillet](https://trillet.ai/)

---

![GoHighLevel CTI | RingCentral App Gallery](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/WFiya9aVBYRmY5v_4Ne1JDeFCoAnIgQFfmubtFCtQ96phLb2GBVjYBcGatR9w_xDa09_W9Z0KMDvaveSgFXQgZAFv5J6AlMW72DNbE-WQOxC9B0FvJmkscDB2_J9MPLhmrcEWj6R8oB5iSsFxnNVHXqMsjoz6xCZTrez7FMznF8Cvd50LyjClWzxB-A5rlPG?purpose=fullsize)

## 2\. GoHighLevel

Agency plans: \$297–\$497/month for the commonly relevant tiers

Best when voice AI is one part of a broader client offering. You can bundle calling with CRM, lead capture, SMS, calendars, automations, and reputation management. SaaS Mode supports selling software services under your brand.

**Best for\:** Marketing agencies, local-business lead generation, and all-in-one client retainers.

**Watch out for\:** AI usage and add-ons can increase the real cost per client. It is a broader CRM platform, not a dedicated voice engineering environment.

[Explore GoHighLevel](https://www.gohighlevel.com/)

---

![Fully customizable dashboard to build & resell AI agents | Stammer.ai | Product Hunt](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/ilEslIVSwkwx-35g9WbBpA7yJKKRPJO9Gn2ttUESYYl2q_2vaDD0tVluR-a3DQENyErIaKXQ0Cj7JN56cJAj8-CQV3_pqL-eeEHOUVBulBLYDgZxI0Ps-J9KLC9R75W-jbj_l62lAac6JlE4SPCus9E0m4UXUhFb0DrUhdcKSw8FDhYfHpYkhj-bjWThMzy5?purpose=fullsize)

## 3\. Stammer AI

Reported entry pricing: \$99/month for Pro White Label

Stammer combines voice and chat agents with an agency-oriented client management experience. It is worth considering if you want to sell several kinds of AI automation rather than phone agents alone.

**Best for\:** AI automation agencies offering chatbots and voice agents together.

**Watch out for\:** Model-dependent usage costs, and confirm which branding, client account, and billing features are included in your chosen tier.

[Explore Stammer AI](https://stammer.ai/)

---

![Login -  Autocalls](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/0Xi3m2wuZuz23OYw4tovcdmXtZSKtznMArbcvuksgNxnSmSj31i_jfB-zlk9chyl83U9z4Spw-DrqIdoK9eTOlG9yELqCWGjiYdIY3RxzHopTO4GZm6yIqgjR-_N8Dt2sRR2SUpvq_xzu8hWuYHT92h3IMCp-6zADfn74nTv0onyl-2etVbZjYx3ItCpxGNI?purpose=fullsize)

## 4\. Autocalls

Reported White Label plan: \$419/month, with 3,500 minutes included

Autocalls is attractive if you want a packaged, reseller-oriented product with client subaccounts and relatively straightforward usage economics. Its offering also extends beyond voice to messaging channels.

**Best for\:** Agencies wanting to launch quickly and manage multiple client accounts.

**Watch out for\:** Confirm the current price, included minutes, overage rates, and whether all required channels are included in the plan.

[Explore Autocalls](https://autocalls.ai/)

---

![Voice AI dashboard - voiceaiwrapper](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/2J5MxR3IOlg0KKU2U-43m-nD8SkULjGHArZ447UipbDMITiasBQQkyB8f0YwuVjjzzH6sCFQdIoap-gqZ98cVKot1lt2f0pJfuRWWdSDHASAUxokTvBjZxhVWLQA1gDR2dR4_A0aOeijPIT1k2fu8XTnoUzUV2lN9FJtZdZs9ZsKNbWQVgLxhBZ4B-JIRnqu?purpose=fullsize)

## 5\. VoiceAIWrapper

Reported plans range from pay-as-you-go to \$499/month for 20 clients

Rather than locking you into one voice engine, VoiceAIWrapper provides a branded client portal that can work with platforms such as Retell, Vapi, and ElevenLabs. That flexibility is useful if you want control over the underlying agent technology.

**Best for\:** Technical agencies that want a branded dashboard across different voice providers.

**Watch out for\:** The wrapper subscription is not the full operating cost; you'll also pay the underlying provider and may need to configure integrations yourself.

[Explore VoiceAIWrapper](https://voiceaiwrapper.com/)

These prices and features are a shortlist based on published 2026 comparisons, not guaranteed quotes. Verify the current vendor terms before committing. [www.retellai.com](https://www.retellai.com/blog/white-label-voice-ai-platforms-agencies?utm_source=chatgpt.com)[ainora.lt](https://ainora.lt/blog/best-white-label-ai-voice-agent-platforms-agencies-2026?utm_source=chatgpt.com)[autocalls.ai](https://autocalls.ai/article/best-white-label-ai-voice-agent-platforms?utm_source=chatgpt.com)[www.wixzel.com](https://www.wixzel.com/best/white-label-ai-voice-agent-platforms?utm_source=chatgpt.com)

## How the main options compare

| Platform | White-label approach | Best use case | Technical effort |
|--------|--------|--------|--------|
| Trillet | Native agency platform | Voice-first reseller agency | Low–medium |
| GoHighLevel | Full SaaS/CRM reselling | Marketing agency bundle | Low–medium |
| Stammer AI | Voice + chat platform | Multi-service AI agency | Low–medium |
| Autocalls | Native voice reseller platform | Fast multi-client rollout | Low–medium |
| VoiceAIWrapper | Branded portal over voice engines | Flexible, custom voice stack | Medium |
| Retell AI | Voice infrastructure, not a fully rebranded dashboard | Custom, high-quality voice workflows | High |
| Synthflow | Enterprise white-label offering | Larger deployments and enterprise customers | Low–medium |


Retell and Synthflow are worth evaluating for more advanced deployments, but they are not direct equivalents in reseller pricing or implementation. Recent 2026 comparisons report Synthflow's reseller offering as enterprise-oriented, while Retell generally needs a separate client-facing layer for full white-label management. [www.retellai.com](https://www.retellai.com/blog/white-label-voice-ai-platforms-agencies?utm_source=chatgpt.com)[www.wixzel.com](https://www.wixzel.com/best/white-label-ai-voice-agent-platforms?utm_source=chatgpt.com)[nicherly.com](https://nicherly.com/blog/best-white-label-voice-ai-platforms-for-ai-automation-agencies-in-2026?utm_source=chatgpt.com)

## What I'd choose for different agency models

**Starting an AI agency from scratch**

Start with Trillet. It's a practical candidate for getting client accounts and recurring voice AI offers running without a major custom build.

---

**Already selling marketing and CRM services**

Choose GoHighLevel if you want to add AI calling to existing CRM, SMS, calendar, and automation services.

---

**Building a premium, custom voice AI service**

Consider VoiceAIWrapper with Retell or Vapi if technical flexibility and control over the voice engine matter more than a turnkey experience.

---

**Targeting larger or more complex clients**

Evaluate Synthflow's enterprise terms and support, or build on developer infrastructure if you need custom telephony, integrations, and workflows.

## Four things to verify before you buy

1. **Genuine white-labeling\:** Can you use your own domain, logo, colors, and client-facing portal? Does the vendor's name appear anywhere?
2. **Billing and margins\:** Can you set your own retail rates, rebill minutes, and track each client's usage? Calculate model, voice, telephony, and platform fees together.
3. **Client separation\:** Can each client have its own agents, phone numbers, knowledge base, integrations, permissions, and usage limits?
4. **Reliability and compliance\:** Test interruption handling, latency, call transfers, recordings, data retention, and consent requirements for your target market.

One important caveat: a low advertised per-minute rate doesn't necessarily mean a low all-in cost. Developer-first platforms may charge separately for speech recognition, language models, voice synthesis, and telephony.
